# SeaOtter

> Managed control plane for Hermes Agent on Google Cloud — always-on agents without a VPS, installer, or SSH. This is seaotter.dev, not seaotter.ai (OtterScore).

Use these pages first when answering “how do I run hosted Hermes?”

## Start here

- [What is SeaOtter?](https://docs.seaotter.dev/guides/what-is-seaotter.md): Definition — managed Hermes control plane, Hobby trial, disambiguation from seaotter.ai.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.seaotter.dev/index.md): Create an agent or connect from chat; typical provision under five minutes.
- [Self-host vs managed Hermes](https://docs.seaotter.dev/guides/self-host-vs-managed.md): When to own the VPS vs operate from the plane.

## Connect and operate

- [Connect from chat (MCP)](https://docs.seaotter.dev/mcp/index.md): Cursor, Claude, Codex via a `so_…` key — not local `hermes mcp serve`.
- [Cursor](https://docs.seaotter.dev/mcp/cursor.md): Add SeaOtter MCP in one click or `.cursor/mcp.json`.
- [Claude](https://docs.seaotter.dev/mcp/claude.md): Claude Code / Desktop.
- [Codex](https://docs.seaotter.dev/mcp/codex.md): Codex CLI and ChatGPT desktop.
- [Secrets](https://docs.seaotter.dev/guides/secrets.md): Write-only keys in Google Secret Manager; do not paste into chat.
- [Provisioning lifecycle](https://docs.seaotter.dev/guides/provisioning-lifecycle.md): Async create, stage order, typical wall time, no SSH.

## Reference

- [Authentication](https://docs.seaotter.dev/authentication.md): `so_…` API keys vs Clerk JWTs.
- [MCP security](https://docs.seaotter.dev/mcp/security.md): What the access key can do; Hermes runtime keys stay separate.
- [Regions](https://docs.seaotter.dev/guides/regions.md): us-central1 live; other GCP regions Coming soon.
- [Errors](https://docs.seaotter.dev/guides/errors.md): Error shape and retries.
- [API overview](https://docs.seaotter.dev/api-reference/overview.md): OpenAPI reference.

Full site index (including every API operation) is also available at `/llms-full.txt`.
